name: Town Heroes
storyline:
The kingdom that once protected the towns is long gone. No crown answers the horns any more, so every town raises its own heroes — and every hero answers to the town that made them.

Beyond the walls lies half-wild country: broken roads, old battlefields and ground no one has cleared in a generation. Bands of heroes ride out into it to hunt what has moved in, because a town that cannot arm and feed itself does not last the winter. What they bring back — steel, gems, and the knowledge of what is coming — is the difference between a wall and a ruin. Because what lives out there does not stay out there. It comes to the gates in waves, and holding the gate is the whole of it. A town is worth exactly as much as the heroes standing in front of it when the horns sound.

And towns do not only fight monsters. With no kingdom to arbitrate, rivalries are settled the old way: hero against hero, town against town, in arenas where the only thing that matters is who is still standing.
summary: Town Heroes is a real-time action RPG for Android, iOS and Steam. It is a game you play, not one you watch: skill-shot abilities, positioning and timing decide every fight. Players build a hero through levels, skill and talent trees, equipment, enchanting and gems, then take that build into ranked PvP arenas and open-world monster hunts, solo or with their clan. Between battles the town comes alive: fish by the river, make a wish at the fountain, sing at the Ancestors' Monument and gather with your clan. One account carries a hero across all three platforms, on authoritative servers built and operated by the studio.
